svg.text: Decided before the sketch: proportions, landmarks, attachment points, the empty mouth zone, and a 2D estimate at the game camera (26 m, pitch 42, yaw 20).
A. EXPLORE: 8 thumbnails at the game camera (x3). Eye line from v5 (150) up to 104; neck 48 or 64 units under the eye line.
- a clear gap for the empty
tie into the arm and hem zone
B. FRONT LANDMARKS (upright, symmetric). Units: front-view units, body 265 crown-to-hem.
Head = crown to neck line = 130 units.
Whole body = crown to lowest hem lobe
Width at the arm roots 208 (1.6 hh);
arms reach 2.15 hh tip to tip. v5 size kept.
Eye line y 118 (v5 150): 30% down the body.
Ear points: on the eye line, at the side
Neck line y 166: a small centred collar.
The collar and the knot sit BELOW the
Chest: y 186-258, centre. The tie lies here.
Arm roots: y 190-260, soft shoulder on top
and below; arm tips below the eye bottom
(y 131) at rest and in the wave.
Hem: 5 soft lobes round the body; 3 seen
from the front, a notch centred at the back.
the crown, a cup on each ear point
the collar at the neck line
tie and collar inside the outline
D. GAME-CAMERA ESTIMATE (x3; tile 3 also at 1x, right)
1 v5 crop 2 model on the v5 eye line 3 body map v2 (tie; blue box = mouth zone)
4 headset 5 glasses. Model check: v5 eyes measured 56% down the ghost
(lineup crop, ink bbox y 33-158, eyes y 99-107); model gives 55%.
Knot top lands 7.0 px (1x) under the eye dots; the V point 17.0 px under them.
Opinion: the centred tie is a vertical lilac stripe under the face. It is
the one risk to the no-mouth read; Viet's real render must prove it.
